principles: Use the authoritative story worktree for git state and diff decisions; keep metadataRoot for story metadata, config, and material-hash exclusion semantics.
Fail closed on real scope violations and never acknowledge or whitelist unrelated metadataRoot dirt.
Keep the runtime behavior change narrow, reviewable, and covered by a focused regression smoke.
Apply Proofbound CLI lifecycle discipline: patch bump, build, version output, review, test, summary, and DONE preparation remain required.
drivers: A downstream story is blocked because scope/preflight gates can observe unrelated dirty files outside the authoritative story worktree.
B-08be changes Proofbound CLI gate behavior, so it is high-risk process/runtime work with strict role and evidence boundaries.
Scope reviewer evidence must remain reviewer-written; the implementation owner can plan and implement but must not self-sign PLAN scope review.

options.name: Resolve git cwd at scope gate boundaries
pros: Matches existing evidence freshness and dirty-gate patterns that already call resolveGitCwd.
Keeps metadataRoot available for metadata storage and material-hash exclusions.
Limits the change to the scope contract handler and lifecycle scope transition gate.
cons: Requires focused regression coverage for both direct scope_contract_check and story_advance lifecycle rendering paths.

options.name: Thread git cwd through all low-level diff-pack APIs
pros: Makes cwd choice explicit at lower layers.
Could help future non-story callers reason about git roots.
cons: Wider API churn across core helpers for the same immediate bug.
Higher risk of mixing metadataRoot and gitCwd semantics in unrelated callers.

options.name: Whitelist unrelated metadataRoot dirty paths
pros: Could unblock one observed case quickly.
cons: Hides real scope violations and trains the gate to ignore the wrong data source.
Does not prove the authoritative story worktree is being used.

chosen: Resolve git cwd at scope gate boundaries
rationale: The chosen option fixes the actual cwd authority bug at the smallest gate boundary while preserving metadataRoot for story metadata and material-hash semantics.

preMortem.scenario: Lifecycle scope gate still reads metadataRoot after the direct command is fixed.
preMortem.trigger: runScopeTransitionGate continues to pass ctx.root directly into runScopeGate.
preMortem.consequence: story_advance REVIEW/TEST can still block on unrelated workspace dirt.
preMortem.mitigation: Add a regression where metadataRoot is dirty but the authoritative story worktree only has allowed files; assert lifecycle scope rows only include story worktree paths.

preMortem.scenario: Material freshness semantics drift while fixing git cwd.
preMortem.trigger: A helper starts resolving config or material exclusions from gitCwd instead of metadataRoot.
preMortem.consequence: Evidence hashes can be recorded or compared against the wrong story metadata exclusions.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep metadataRoot threaded into material-hash calls and restrict this change to git diff/status cwd resolution.

preMortem.scenario: Runtime behavior ships without synchronized version proof.
preMortem.trigger: Only LATTICE_CLI_VERSION or only package manifests are bumped, or build/version checks are skipped.
preMortem.consequence: Users cannot tell which global Proofbound CLI contains the gate fix.
preMortem.mitigation: Bump exactly one patch version across package.json, packages/main/package.json, lockfile, and lattice-brand, then run build and lattice --version checks.
